hints.summary: Rotating 5% quarterly categories, activated each quarter; Q4 2026 (Oct 1 to Dec 31): Restaurants, Entertainment and Utilities.

hints.conditions: Activate each quarter; 5% applies from the later of the quarter start or the activation date. U.S. merchants only. Some wallet and third-party payment transactions may not earn 5%.
